notes: Under guideline v1.1, S4.3 and S4.4 are ordinary runtime properties and are interpreted under the reset-disabled operating domain, so omission of an explicit !rst guard is not an error. The global one-hot-or-zero invariant remains literally true during reset because reset drives grant to zero, and the reset-specific S4.2 is correct when evaluated on reset cycles. Idle selection, fixed priority, busy hold, accept clear, no same-edge replacement, and idle-accept behavior are all correctly represented. Final RTL passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
